description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipDao interface which declares methods for accessing product relationship data in a database, such as retrieving relationships by type, group, or products within the merchant store context.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDao
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao for managing product relationship entities with specialized query methods.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store, type, product, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Lists product relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all product relationship groups within a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store and group.
